QUESTIONS

Before you send a brief.

What information should I share?

Tell us what your business does, the problem you want to solve, and anything you already have, such as a website, an app, brand assets or tools. A rough budget and timeline help, but they’re not required.

Can TexorLab work with an existing website or app?

Yes. We can improve, redesign, extend or connect to what you already have, or rebuild if that makes more sense. We’ll tell you honestly which is better.

Do you work with small businesses?

Yes. Small businesses and startups are a core part of who we work with. We’ll suggest a scope that fits your stage.

Can you automate an existing business process?

Often, yes. Tell us how the process works today and where time is lost. We’ll check whether it can be automated reliably and what that would involve.

Can you handle both design and development?

Yes. Strategy, UX/UI design, development, automation and marketing can all be handled together, so nothing gets lost between teams.

What happens after I submit the form?

We read your brief and contact you using the method you chose to talk through the next step. If we need more detail, we’ll ask. Sending a brief doesn’t commit you to anything.
